title: Diagnose and fix Lakebase issues with Genie, using telemetry in Unity Catalog (Beta)
body: Lakebase adds AI-assisted troubleshooting: database issues and early warnings are surfaced to you with [Insights](/aws/en/oltp/projects/observability-ai-insights), and you can then investigate and fix them conversationally with [Genie](/aws/en/oltp/projects/observability-genie). Both draw on database telemetry captured to Unity Catalog. See [AI-assisted troubleshooting](/aws/en/oltp/projects/ai-assisted-troubleshooting).
